title: Independent External Monitoring of Nestlé's Cocoa Supply Chain in Cameroon, 2021
methodology: Fair Labor Association monitoring visit to Nestlé's cocoa supply chain in Cameroon in 2022 for the 2021 assessment cycle. The report page links the underlying monitoring report.
limitations: The assessment is historical and limited to the assessed supplier chain and locations. The FLA states Nestlé ended its membership as an FLA Participating Company in April 2025; this membership change alone does not establish the current status or effectiveness of all remediation systems.
